title: Right finite scalar quotient formula
statement:
theorem right_quotient_formula_exists
    (b : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ leftComplex l E L ι g ≅
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ rightComplex l E L ι g)
    (hb : CompletedFormula l E L ι g b) :
    ∃ vright : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ rightComplex l E L ι g ⟶
          (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ restrictedRight l E L ι g n,
      RightQuotientFormula l E L ι g vright

proof.text: Use completedScalarModuleArrow and its naturality from the completed scalar comparison construction. It is the canonical map from completed ordinary scalar extension to the restricted finite scalar reduction; completedScalarModuleArrow_tensor gives s tensor x maps to pi_n(s) tensor x in the selected finite presentation.

Apply inverseImageIntegralModules to this natural transformation, then compose with inverseReductionTransport on the finite reduction. This comparison is identity on sections; inverseCoefficient_square proves compatibility of the completed and finite transported actions. Hence the composite is linear over the completed L coefficients.

In degree i take the module transformation at P.X i. Its naturality for the differential proves the chain-map condition, and its naturality for a chain map proves naturality on complexes. Restrict to good complexes. On sections the transport is the identity, so completedScalarModuleArrow_tensor is exactly RightQuotientFormula. The hypotheses b and hb are unnecessary for this construction.
